messages:
Maya Singh: FYI customer ticket #4082 — they retried a streaming call and saw two ledger rows. asking if this is a known race.
Carlos Ortega: can you paste the router trace + the provisional grant events?
Maya Singh: router trace: initial stream -> us-west-2, got short EOF. client retried, CDN sent to us-east-1. both regions issued provisional grants. customer used an unsupported third-party SDK (no session header).
Devon Park: our provisional model was designed exactly like this: each route grants provisional tokens locally. only a segment.confirm converts provisional->confirmed. cross-route retries look like duplicates.
Anya (support): customer is upset because the two rows read like two completed calls in the ledger UI. they assumed double-bill. can we make UI less confusing fast? :grimacing: 
Ben (billing): short-term: we should flag provisional rows clearly and expose the route_id + raw telemetry link so support can show origin to customers. finance won't allow aggressive auto-merges without strong correlation.
Carlos Ortega: telemetry change: emit `stream.session.client_id` if provided, and include `route_id` + `segment_id` in `stream.segment.grant` events. that will enable offline grouping.
Devon Park: SDK ask: recommend `X-Client-Session` header for streaming and document in quickstart. optional but strongly recommended. server-generated ID won't survive CDN retries, so not a full fix.
Maya Singh: console UX idea: add a provisional badge + a hover tooltip that explains "this is a provisional token grant and may be finalized or rolled back" and a "show origin" link that jumps to telemetry. low lift?
Anya (support): that would help a lot. ETA?
Carlos Ortega: small console change — add `provisional_origin` column with `route_id` and `timestamp`. I'll file the frontend ticket.
Ben (billing): long-term reconciliation: billing pipeline can run a conservative merge pass that groups by (customer_id + client_session_id) when session id exists. fallback to an auditable fingerprint: `prompt_prefix(32) + first_confirmed_token + 60s`. mark anything merged via fallback as "requires-review" in audit. never auto-merge entries that include `toolcall.invoked=true`.
Devon Park: agree on never auto-merging toolcall flows. we should also emit `toolcall.idempotency_token` when available and log webhook receipts so finance/legal can verify side effects.
Maya Singh: action items: (1) Carlos — telemetry changes (route_id on grants, session_id passthrough). (2) Frontend — provisional badge + provisional_origin column (Anya to prioritize with support). (3) Dev — SDK docs recommending X-Client-Session. (4) Ben — draft conservative reconcile rules for ops review.
console-bot: task created: frontend/provisional-badge -> PR draft queued.
Anya (support): I'll reply to customer with interim explanation + link to ledger telemetry and offer manual billing review.
Maya Singh: leaving this thread open until console change + telemetry PRs land.
